g.text: B200: fewer KV bytes need not reduce sparse-attention latency
L=65,536; selected compressed KV=512 + sliding window=128; 16 live query heads padded to 64.
Mean and observed min-max across 3 fresh processes. Cold-cache protocols differ between latency and NCU.
Standalone sparse FlashMLA only: not Mega, whole-model decode, task quality or ASIC measurements.
